units.source_text: 每天傍晚时分，我都会邀请查喀和巴咯到这里来做客，教我学习河童的语言。

en.t: Every evening, I would invite Chaka and Bago here as guests and have them teach me the language of the kappa.

units.source_text: 当然，来我这里的河童不仅有他们，因为好奇心，就连玻璃公司的老板嘎尔——查喀量血压的患者，也来过我这里。

en.t: Of course, they were not the only kappa who came to see me; out of curiosity, even Gael, the president of the glass company and one of Chaka's blood-pressure patients, came to my place.

units.source_text: 不过，在刚开始的半个月时间里，我最好的朋友还是渔夫巴咯。

en.t: Still, during the first half month, my best friend remained Bago the fisherman.
